correctness.rationale: Use tetrahedral tight-frame sphere constraints and f_x(t)=sqrt(1+x²-2xt), with strictly concave f'_x for x>0, x≠1. Lagrange intersections at most two t-values; 1+3, 3+1, 2+2 multiplicities are all possible. Tangent Hessian signs show vertex-ray strict min, opposite-ray strict max, 2+2 saddle. x=1 follows continuity and explicit strict saddle comparison, x=0 trivial; connected sphere gives full interval. Independently sampled 25,000 directions across positive radii; no violation, but finite checks do not prove bounds.
